events.text: Follow-up ruling applied in a9ffb8aa3: 'yep that directory is to be ignored' — cart/editor/data is now ignored WHOLESALE (/cart/editor/data/* ) rather than by three named subdirs, so models/, textures/, stickers/ and any future asset dir the editor grows are covered with nothing to keep in sync. One exemption: !/cart/editor/data/*.ts, because that same directory is the editor's source tree (73 tracked .ts — commands, types, meshDoc, the stores). A bare 'cart/editor/data/' makes git skip the directory without descending, so nothing inside can be re-included; ignoring the CONTENTS instead keeps both halves of the ruling true. Verified: models/textures/stickers/loose blob/hypothetical future paints dir all ignored; existing and brand-new .ts visible; all 73 source files still tracked.

resolution: Reconciled the local repo with the GitHub-web cleanup without touching a single file on disk. (1) Re-pointed the corrupt edit-trail ref (bad object from a kernel panic) at HEAD per the documented recovery recipe, which un-broke git fetch and the trail watcher. (3) 183831d14 merges origin/main (your 8 deletion commits) — dry-run proved conflict-free first; both sides agree on every deletion so the merge changed zero worktree files (1975 model files verified on disk before and after). (4) Pushed; the req_3771 merge-faces fix c06ae85a7 rode along.
